source_text: Let's be completely clear about what is happening here: we are witnessing yet another devastating failure of our public systems, driven by decades of systemic neglect and failed fiscal priorities that always end up crushing our most vulnerable communities and working-class families. A parent in the South Portland School District just had to step up and publicly apologize to the educators and staff after finding out the district is facing a massive budget shortfall that's going to slash over 70 positions from our schools. When public education is treated as an afterthought, it's always the workers, the teachers, and our kids who pay the price for these structural inequities. We are talking about gutting the workforce and destabilizing learning environments, and it completely exposes how our current systems fail to value labor or protect public goods. We need a fundamental transformation of our priorities to ensure that education and the workers who provide it are fully funded and protected, instead of leaving communities to pick up the pieces of these recurring budget crises.
rewritten_text: Look at the mess progressive mismanagement has brought us to. Now we see a parent in the South Portland School District having to step up and publicly apologize to the educators and staff over a massive budget shortfall that is going to slash over 70 positions from our schools. This is what happens when traditional values and accountable governance are tossed aside in favor of endless spending and administrative bloat. Our children and hardworking taxpayers are left to pay the price for these recurring budget crises, while the core mission of education gets gutted. It is time to restore order, demand personal responsibility from local leaders, and stop treating our schools as slush funds for failed progressive agendas.
